# TangCai Invest AB

> Independent Swedish company building apps, providing software consulting, and making angel investments.

Official company homepage: https://tangcai.se/
Business contact: info@tangcai.se
Apps privacy policy: https://tangcai.se/apps/privacy/

## Apps

- [SnusTracker](https://tangcai.se/#snustracker): Log snus usage and follow patterns and progress. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752117399) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snustracker).
- [Draw Animations](https://www.drawanimations.com): Create frame-by-frame animations from drawings.
- [Steadsy](https://steadsy.app): Weekly commitments, check-ins, and shared progress. In development; the homepage is not a claim of public download availability.
- [OptionWise](https://home.optionwise.se): Manage employee participation and help employees understand their options.
- [CareMetrics](https://caremetrics.se/sv/): Treatment and outcome analytics for dental teams.

- [Strength Progress Tracker](https://tangcai.se/#strength-progress-tracker): Strength workout logging, sets and reps, training volume, progress, and personal records. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6747354472) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tangcai.gymprogresstracker).

## Company services

- Digital products: useful apps for everyday life and business.
- Software consulting: help bringing software ideas into usable products.
- Angel investments: support for early-stage founders.

The homepage is the primary source. Product websites provide their own current availability and details.
